items.html: And let us return to the matter: for in nursing they were completed as at first, and then each of them had only two vessels, which are the posterior and the middle. And when Gadlut came, ZA took the third inner vessel, and then he enlarged the Nukva from his back into a complete Partzuf up to opposite the Chazeh, which is half his measure, as above; and behold, she was completed like him, although she is half his measure.
